goal: Wait for the opponent (support arm) to discard a mahjong tile, then declare a kong: flip the three tiles in your row that match the discarded tile and put the extra tile (mahjong9_0) upright at the end of your row, with grippers open.
instruction_templates: Wait for the opponent to discard a tile, then declare a kong with the matching tiles.
success: Two stages, in order. Let PUSH be the push tile (one of mahjong5_0..mahjong8_0) chosen per episode from the seed; TARGET = the 3 tiles of the matching group (mahjong0_*->5_0, 1_*->6_0, 2_*->7_0, 3_*->8_0); OTHER = the 9 tiles of the other three groups.

Common to both stages (all at the same action boundary): each of the 3 TARGET tiles has its local z-axis within 30 deg of world up (is_axis_up [0,0,1], thr 30); each of the 9 OTHER tiles has its local y-axis within 7 deg of world up (is_axis_up [0,1,0], thr 7) i.e. they must still be standing as at the start.

Stage 1: common conditions AND mahjong9_0's world orientation quaternion (w,x,y,z) is within 7 deg angular distance of [0, 0.707, 0.707, 0] (is_qpos_close, dis_threshold=7) -- i.e. mahjong9_0 still in its initial pose orientation.

Stage 2: common conditions AND mahjong9_0's local y-axis within 7 deg of world up AND mahjong9_0 origin within 0.015 m (xy, world/table) of (0.319, -0.15) AND all target grippers open (is_all_gripper_open default threshold 0.6).
evaluation: Staged: after every action only the first unpassed stage is tested and removed when it holds; success when both stages are removed (at most one per action). A failure query is also counted every action: FAIL immediately (reward 0, episode over) if at one action boundary [left_arm OR right_arm not back to origin (pos > 0.3 m on any axis or rot > 30 deg from start)] AND [support_arm0 not back to origin (pos > 0.3 m on any axis or rot > 40 deg)] -- i.e. do not move the arms far while the opponent's arm is still moving. Otherwise fails at step_lim (600 actions).
objects: mahjong0_0..0_2, 1_0..1_2, 2_0..2_2, 3_0..3_2: four groups of 3 identical tiles (category mahjong, one model per group), the agent's hand, standing in a row at table y=-0.15, x = -0.325,-0.279,-0.233 / -0.187,-0.141,-0.095 / -0.049,-0.003,0.043 / 0.089,0.135,0.181 (place_tag straight_front, fixed, no yaw randomness)
mahjong4_0, 4_1: two identical tiles of another model at y=-0.15, x=0.227, 0.273
mahjong5_0..8_0: four 'push' tiles, each the same model as groups 0..3 respectively, standing at table y=0.05, x=0.0, 0.046, -0.046, -0.092 (place_tag straight_back)
other0 at (-0.4,-0.05) and other1 at (-0.4,-0.002) lying down; other2 stacked on other1; mahjong9_0 stacked on other0, same model as mahjong4_0 (decor/props)
scene_dynamics: The support arm (non-target Franka, robot_config dual_x5_and_franka_competition) replays a pre-recorded trajectory chosen by the push tile's rank when the 4 push tiles are sorted by x (0..3) -- it performs the opponent's 'discard' motion. It is queued after the agent's first action and plays in lock-step with the agent's actions. Afterwards the scene is checked once; if the push tile's local z is NOT within 30 deg of world up the sample is flagged unstable and dropped.
needs_memory_or_language: Yes, visual reasoning: the agent must observe which push tile (and hence which group of 3 identical tiles in its row) the opponent handled, and act on the matching group. No numbers are given; the instruction does not name the tile.
end_requirements: Stage 2 requires all target grippers open (>= 0.6). No back-to-origin check, but arms must not stray beyond 0.3 m/30 deg during the support arm's motion (failure query).
notes: Orientation conventions (which tile axis is face-up, what 'flipped' means physically) cannot be determined statically; the code only tests: TARGET tiles local z up (<=30 deg), others local y up (<=7 deg), mahjong9_0 initial quaternion within 7 deg then y-up at (0.319,-0.15) within 1.5 cm. The exact role of mahjong9_0 (apparently the 'discarded' tile that must be stood at the row end) is inferred; the code does not say. Which group is TARGET is only known at runtime (seeded random choice made in process_execution_order); labels kong[j] are the group's tiles sorted by x but order does not matter for success. Stage 1 requires mahjong9_0 to be still unrotated, so move mahjong9_0 only after the three TARGET tiles are in their final orientation and the 9 other tiles stay upright throughout. Docstring of check_support_arm_stable says 'still upright => unstable' but the code does the opposite (marks unstable if NOT up) -- docstring/code mismatch, code governs. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
